verdict_reason: Removing the contact address and issuer assertion and title wording is correct, but the file's comments carry version history and mapping rationale that belong in docs.

todos.issue: The file's comments carry schema-version history and describe another system. '// [FROM v0.2.0]', '// [FROM v0.3.0]' and '// [FROM v0.1.0: NOT MAPPED?]' (lines 39, 66, 75, 97, 101, 107) record which PIMS schema version added a field and guess at a cause. The path comments give each GBN-AG field's mapping to a Dynamics column. The fixme message on line 25 points readers to those comments for 'the likely cause'. House rules: no history in comments, rationale lives in docs/, and a comment never describes another module.
todos.fix: Must: the spec holds no version-history or likely-cause comments, and the field-to-column mapping and suspected causes live in a doc the fixme can name. One way: move the mapping and causes into docs/analysis/gbn-ag-field-lineage.md or the PIMS mapping doc, point the fixme message there, and delete the comments.
